caption: The drawing depicts a wooden secretary desk with a hutch on top. The hutch features two large, arched cabinet doors, one of which is open to reveal several small interior compartments and shelves with decorative cutouts. The wood is a reddish-brown color with visible grain patterns, and the doors have inset panels with molded borders. Below the hutch, the desk has a slanted drop-front writing surface, which is closed. Directly below the writing surface are three rows of drawers: the top row contains two smaller drawers side by side, while the two lower rows each consist of a single, wide drawer. All drawers are fitted with ornate brass handles and keyholes. The desk rests on four large, rounded bun feet. The background of the drawing is a solid, light beige color, and there is a handwritten signature on the lower right side.
title: Secretary
